implemented: Five selected existing CC0 B46 props, normalized by measured bounds with grounded collision; existing authored market stalls reused
Photographic CC0 stone paving with world-space scale and mipmaps; surface meets physical terrain
World dirt-road overlays stop inside the capital so they cannot paint over paving; bridge and terrain physics unchanged
Readable bounded night ambient fill and warm evening stall lanterns
Square artisan and trader use actual bench/stall/home/meal/social positions
Player can sell wood and stone; artisan consumes the existing arrow recipe at the workbench over eight seconds and replenishes finite merchant stock; progress and stock survive streaming
Map retains actual street furniture footprints beneath living markers
47 cm bench seats and reduced daytime overexposure
Composed VFX use weak-reference expiry so early owner deletion does not trigger freed-object callbacks
Capital paving resolves as stone; ordinary walking emits no soil prints or stone fragments
journey_method: External autopilot against the frozen exported PCK. Ordinary Input movement, run speed/stamina/gravity unchanged; no driver position assignment. Headless --fixed-fps 60 uses 1/60-second simulation steps and time scale 1, but can execute faster than wall time. Explicit test supplies: ten berries and ten water flasks. Arrival save retained.
graphical: Square traversal/grounding/recipe/trade/streaming/map/light smoke and full gameplay-actions smoke with four quality presets, equipment, melee, bow/ammo and ten spells.
native: Official game loaded the real prior arrival save for visual review. First inspection found brown world-road overlays hiding paving; fixed and rechecked. A separate native inspection helper then loaded the earned save and walked to the stalls through ordinary Input, without driver position assignment. Only this visual fixture holds the clock at 09:00 and then 20:00 for comparable day/night renders. Viewport captures are from the actual game, not mockups. Final observations are recorded in the development status.
test_sequence: Fifteen baseline scenarios passed after removing the duplicate dirt overlay. Square/citizen cases repeated after making workshop activity wait honestly for missing materials. Native approach exposed VFX lifetime errors and wrong soil-step effects on paving; five affected/new scenarios passed after fixing ownership and surface semantics, giving seventeen unique scenarios. No smoke gate weakened.
known_issues: Not Witcher 3 realism: simple human materials, unfinished grip and sparse flat forest remain
Ordinary capital houses remain closed collision shells; repeated architecture and oversized city spaces remain
Two square workers have a concrete supply loop; the rest of the city is not a complete reactive society or external AI
Workshop recipe has timed work and real inventory effects, not detailed hand/tool assembly animation
Known ObjectDB warnings at shutdown; full FPS/memory and remote stable release gates not completed
